Hi Tom — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from my side and one small question about timing: 

Summary from our call:
- Primary use case: customer support triage and automated reply suggestions to cut average handle time by ~30%
- Current constraints: on-prem data retention and requirement for audit logs (SOC2) for any external vendor
- Success metric you called out: reduce escalations by 20% within Q4 pilot window

What I can do next:
- Share an abbreviated pilot plan (6 weeks) and an implementation checklist for your infra team
- Run a quick, scoped POC with one support queue and synthetic traffic to validate latency and cost numbers

Quick question: where does this land on your Q3 roadmap/decision horizon? Are you aiming to start pilots in July or later? If youre still estimating, no problem — just helpful for our planning.

Attached: demo-notes.pdf (3-page recap + a few screenshots).

If its useful I can also propose a 15-minute follow-up with our solutions engineer to walk the pilot outline. Calendly link below.
